usedFor: Action items from each Recall.ai meeting transcript land in Asana as an assigned task with dates and a description.

bestTemplate.name: “New Transcript Completed” in Recall.ai, then “Create Task or Subtask” in Asana
bestTemplate.why: The task arrives ready to work, with assignee, tags, dates and the transcript's description filled in.

watchOut: Avoid “New Webhook Event” for Asana tasks, since it fires on every status and duplicates tasks per meeting.
